description: A contract that exists to exercise the wire forms the format grew keys for.

Every shape here is one that could not be written before: a value whose wire spelling is not an identifier, a field that is null rather than absent, a field whose absence has a value, a union tagged by its key rather than inside itself, an arm that carries a whole shape, a field whose keys are its parent's, and a shape imported from somewhere else.
The event envelope, shared with every other contract that carries events. Restating it here would be a second definition with nothing saying the two are the same.

types.name: Backend
description: Which backend a session runs against.

variants.name: claude_code
description: Two words on the wire, hyphenated. A live TypeScript consumer reads this exact spelling, so it is the contract and not a rendering choice.

variants.name: codex
description: One word, so the name and the wire value are the same and only one of them is written.

types.name: KindFilter
description: Which backends a read keeps.
Externally tagged because each arm carries a list, and there is nowhere inside a JSON array to put a discriminator key.

variants.name: only
description: Keep rows whose backend is in the set. An empty set keeps nothing.

variants.name: except
description: Drop rows whose backend is in the set. An empty set drops nothing.

types.name: Filter
description: The row predicate for one read. Every field is null rather than absent, because that is the form this wire already had before it was written down.

fields.name: since_ms
description: Exclusive lower bound, or null for the start of the log.

fields.name: kinds
description: The backend filter, or null for no filtering.

types.name: ListParams
description: What a listing takes. Both fields have a value when nobody said, which is what makes the empty object a complete request.

fields.name: include_history
description: Whether to merge ended sessions into the answer.

Absent means true, which is what a person looking at a list wants. A caller that only needs the live population sets it false; a reader who assumed false would quietly get a different answer than the contract gives.

fields.name: filter
description: The row predicate. Absent means the filter that selects everything.

types.name: Session
description: What starting a session takes.

fields.name: backend
description: Which backend to run.

fields.name: working_dir
description: Where the backend runs. Resolved on the producer's machine.

types.name: StartArgs
description: What this contract's start takes: the caller's own request, plus what this producer needs on top of it.
The request is carried whole and its keys are the ones on the wire. Re-spelling them here would be a second definition of a shape the caller already sends.

fields.name: session
description: The caller's request. Not a key: its own keys are written here.

fields.name: max_event_ts
description: The resume seed, when the caller has one. Absent rather than null, because there is nothing to say and this field was written after the recommendation.

types.name: Event
description: One thing that happened.

fields.name: meta
description: When it happened and which way it went.

fields.name: line
description: The raw line that crossed.

types.name: Cursor
description: Where a reader has got to. Nothing here is larger than a machine word, which is what decides whether a target passes it by value.

fields.name: meta
description: The last envelope seen.

types.name: Item
description: One item on the watch stream.

The event arm carries the event whole rather than restating its keys: a consumer that already holds one puts it on the stream and takes it off again, instead of taking it apart at one end and rebuilding it at the other.

variants.name: event
description: One event. Its keys sit beside the discriminator.

variants.name: gap
description: Events this reader will never receive, reported rather than skipped.

fields.name: lost
description: How many, as an upper bound.

ops.name: demo.wire.list
description: Every matching event.

ops.name: demo.wire.latest
description: The newest matching event, or nothing at all when there is none. Not an absent result: this op answers, and sometimes the answer is that there is none.

ops.name: demo.wire.start
description: Start a session and answer where its stream begins.

ops.name: demo.wire.watch
description: The session's items, as they happen.
